units: Gen. R. s. 60 (ref. to Gen. XXIV, 60) ועמדו … ור׳ מיעקב from her (Rebekah) arose chiefs (allufim) of Esau, and myriads of Jacob; a. e.—Pl. רְבָבוֹת, constr. רִבֵּי, רִיבֵּי.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 89:9">Gen. R. s. 89</cite> (play on <he>ר̇ה̇ב̇ים</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 40:5">Ps. XL, 5</cite>) <he>ה̇מון ר̇יב̇י רַבְרְבַיָּא שהם וכ׳</he> (he regarded not) the noise of the myriads of great (boastful) men, for they turn after lies (v., however, <cite ref="T00147"><he>רַבְרְבָא</he></cite>).—V. <cite ref="T00064"><he>רִבּוֹא</he></cite>.
